scope: Synthetic aggregation/model restoration, mocked pre-completion gate, math and source inspection only. No held-out corpus loading, real checkpoints, training, or timing.
findings: Full WikiText/FineWeb rows scored in order; aligned document group IDs retained for later grouped bootstrap. Statistical aggregation/bootstrap code is not included in these scripts and needs later audit.

Missing900s snapshots are marked unavailable; comparison must restrict to truly matched available seeds and report gaps. Missing required final.pt should raise rather than share optional-threshold handling.

Strengthen preflight: all6 result/task completed statuses, expected steps, and final checkpoint hashes should be checked before held-out sets loaded. Current pipeline completion flag gates access and orchestrator sets it only after all runs.
Benchmark must run serially after evaluation exits. Pipeline training_complete alone does not exclude another post-training job.
Unigram uses only training byte counts with half-count smoothing; diagnostic rotates selected prefixes, not independent random permutation, and may preserve same-document context.
Standalone inference is after45 throwaway training updates; clearly labeled runtime-only, not final-checkpoint quality. No saved parameters modified.
Peak RSS is combined process high-water mark, not architecture-specific memory usage.
CPU-only fixed128-position dense FP32 benchmark cannot establish GPU speed, broad intelligence, or 600B transfer.
